en.title: Happy Neighbourhood
en.description:
Houses are numbered 1..N, and people move in one house at a time in the order of the given permutation. Find the earliest day on which some contiguous segment of M houses is fully occupied.

The explicit standard input/output format and additional constraints on this site define the online version and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The input contains N, M and a permutation of length N. 1≤N≤100000, 1≤M≤N.
en.output: Output the day on which a fully occupied contiguous segment of length M first appears.
en.explanation: Record the move-in day of each house. For each contiguous window of length M, take the maximum move-in day, then take the minimum over all windows.
